methodologyNotes: 13 notable robot vacuums selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, spanning flagship self-emptying all-in-one docks, mid-range combo-mop units, and the newest 2026 releases. Seeds from the brief (iRobot Roomba j9+, Combo j9+, Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra, Q Revo, Ecovacs DEEBOT X2 Omni, T30 Omni, Eufy X10 Pro Omni, Shark AI Ultra, Dreame L20 Ultra) were evaluated; the 'Q Revo' and 'T30 Omni' seeds were replaced with more current/better-documented equivalents (Roborock Qrevo CurvX and Ecovacs T90 Pro Omni) after research showed those as the in-market successors with verified specs. Shark AI Ultra could not be confirmed as a current US SKU — SharkNinja's US site no longer lists it; it was dropped (null beats fabrication) and replaced with three strong 2025-2026 products with verifiable specs: Ecovacs X12 OmniCyclone, Roborock Saros 10R, and Dreame X50 Ultra. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (irobot.com, us.roborock.com, ecovacs.com, eufy.com). Key fallback: vacuumwars.com (independent reviewer with declared no-sponsorship policy) for suction Pa official ratings, battery life, and prices where manufacturer pages returned 404 or blocked access. Corroboration: digitaltrends.com reviews for price and release date cross-check. specKeys chosen for real comparability across all 13 units: suction_pa (numeric, official maximum Pa), mapping (string, primary navigation technology name), self_empty (bool), mopping (bool), battery_min (numeric, official rated runtime in minutes on a single charge; low-power mode where two figures given), obstacle_avoidance (string, technology/objects-recognized summary), app (string, companion app name), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). suction_pa: iRobot does not publish Pa figures — those entries are null (confirmed absence, not an omission). battery_min for Roomba models not published by iRobot — null. priceUsd = US MSRP / launch retail price in USD; for models still actively sold at launch price this matches current list price; models with significant post-launch discounts note the original MSRP in priceNote. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.
